dataset.name: CreiLOV combinatorial fluorescence landscape
dataset.selection_reason: Benign fluorescent-protein combinatorial benchmark with higher-order variants; no CreiLOV dataset name or outcomes were present in the NABU repository history search before this preregistration.

sealed_split.visible: all measured variants with mutation_count <= 3, including WT if present
sealed_split.hidden_candidate_pool: all measured variants with mutation_count in {4,5}; identities visible to Stage A, fitness physically absent from Stage A files
sealed_split.higher_mutation_counts: not used in this test to stay inside the previously validated NABU 3-5 mutation scoring regime

architecture.name: NABU V8.3 Dual-Objective Router
architecture.higher_order: cross-fitted triplet/quartet residual hierarchy from frozen V8.1 mechanics
architecture.global_gate: if visible OOF B4 Spearman > B3 OOF Spearman, use global B5
architecture.elite_gate: otherwise allow rank-preserving B5 rerank only inside frozen B3 top-20% when visible OOF elite Top-50 mean percentile improves and Top-1%-hit count does not decrease

primary_endpoints: Top-50 count of true hidden Top-1% variants
secondary_endpoints: Top-50 count of true hidden Top-0.1% variants

anti_leakage.stage_0: deterministically packages raw XLSX into visible labels, hidden identities, and a separate sealed hidden-truth file; no fitness values are printed
anti_leakage.stage_A: loads visible labels + hidden identities only, fits and scores, writes candidate freeze + prediction hashes, then exits
anti_leakage.stage_B: verifies Stage-A hashes before loading the sealed hidden-truth file and computing evaluation metrics
